description: This grouped bar chart illustrates the CoLeG-R (%) achieved across three distinct model categories under four different training conditions. The horizontal axis represents the categories, ordered from left to right, with the first category label completely obscured by a solid grey rectangle, followed by "LLaMA-2-13B" and "LLaMA-2-70B". The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "CoLeG-R (%)", using a linear scale that ranges from 0 to 80 (with bars extending up to approximately 85), with numeric tick marks spaced at regular intervals of 10. Within each of the three categories, there is a group of four vertical bars arranged side-by-side, corresponding to a legend located in the bottom right corner. The first bar in each group represents "no SFT" and is colored light blue with diagonal white hatching; the second represents "+ SFT on $D_0$" and is light orange with horizontal white hatching; the third represents "+ SFT on $D_0, D_1$" and is light purple with diagonal white hatching; and the fourth represents "+ SFT on $D_0, D_1, D_2$" and is solid light pink. Across the chart, the lowest values are observed in the first obscured category for the "no SFT" and "+ SFT on $D_0$" conditions, both at approximately 66%. The highest value appears in the "LLaMA-2-13B" category for the "+ SFT on $D_0, D_1$" condition, reaching approximately 85%. The values in the "LLaMA-2-70B" category are the most uniform, with all four bars ranging between approximately 81% and 84%. The bars are not sorted by height, but rather follow the consistent order defined by the legend within each group, and the first category label on the horizontal axis is visually altered by being blocked out with a grey box.
